srList.sentence: In terms of histopathological type, the 122 patients included 79 patients with ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma, 28 patients with ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and 15 patients with ovarian endometrioid carcinoma; in terms of clinical staging according to the criteria released by the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO), there were 10 patients at stage I, 36 patients at stage II, 64 patients at stage III, and 12 patients at stage IV; in terms of differentiation according to grading criteria released by the WHO, there were 15 patients with high differentiation, 33 patients with moderate differentiation, and 74 patients without differentiation.
